title: Face Sculpt #029 · 일본 30대 · 냉혹한 · 사이렌 눈 +1 · 둥근 베이비 페이스 · 강남언니 · P15 · 귀 철 추
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the line of her shoulders, the frame cutting off just below them, so the weights fully hang in view. Her face is large and sharp. Mid 30s.

Subject: A real photograph of a striking adult Japanese woman — Japanese poised refined beauty light-neutral complexion with a soft peach-beige undertone and real visible pores, mid 30s, sleek black shoulder-length hair with a side part, extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: a precise winged liner, softly defined brown eyeshadow, full natural lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, sculpted contour with a satin highlight, plump glossy rose-coral lips, odd-eyed with two clearly different lenses: her left eye has a glowing amber-gold coloured contact lens with a greatly enlarged dilated pupil, fully opaque and solidly saturated across the whole iris with no natural brown showing through, the colour bright and unmistakable, with a darker limbal ring, and her right eye has a neon lime-green coloured contact lens with a vertical slit cat-eye pupil, fully opaque and solidly saturated across the whole iris with no natural brown showing through, the colour bright and unmistakable, with a darker limbal ring, sitting naturally on the irises and clear of the eyelids, the two eye colours both bright and clearly different from each other, a cold narrowed stare without a trace of warmth straight through the camera, brows low and still, lips pressed in a thin flat line, an icy, ruthless, merciless expression — a photograph of a real Japanese woman's face, not an illustration, not a render. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living skin with visible pores and faint peach-fuzz hairs, slightly asymmetrical with a few small natural beauty marks and freckles, never airbrushed and never smooth like plastic, real wet catchlights in the eyes, individual hair strands catching the light. Her face has been surgically sculpted far beyond her natural look, and these changes override her natural features: her eyes are the star of her face (the shape, size and lenses described here override the eyes of her makeup, while the colours of her eyeshadow and liner follow her makeup): extreme siren eyes: very long, very narrow, strongly upturned eyes with the outer corners lifted high and stretched far out toward the temples in a long, razor-sharp upswept cat flick, a pronounced catlike inner point, thick smoky black kohl liner on the waterline and an extremely long, straight, razor-sharp wing reaching toward her temples, heavy dark lashes, in deep amber contact lenses with a big visible iris, both eyes the same, with a round natural pupil and bright catchlights; her nose: a very steep, sharply sculpted surgical nose: a knife-like bridge that rises steeply and sharply from the brow, a needle-pointed tip projecting well forward, and very narrow, tightly pinched nostril wings with thin, slit-like nostrils; her jawline and chin: a soft, round 'baby face' jaw: full, plump, rounded cheeks, a short, soft, rounded jawline with no sharp angles and a small, round, slightly full chin. Every feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, in harmony with the rest of her face, never distorted, never grotesque.

Piercings: A face fully covered with real piercings, about twelve in total (not counting the hanging weights), spread over every area so that no area is empty: a single large septum ring of different sizes and shapes through the thin soft wall between the nostrils, in a short stack that ends above the upper lip; one small ring wrapping snugly around each nostril wing; one small hoop or stud along the edge of the upper lip; one small hoop or stud across the lower lip's edge; one small ring or stud on the chin; on each ear, one large healed opening in the earlobe holding a very thick, heavy black cast-iron ring as thick as a finger, a plain solid ring with no open tunnel, and above it sit one thick classic round O-rings and studs along the helix rim above the lobe; one small stud along each cheekbone, well clear of the eyes. Fine chains link the pieces: from the upper ear hoop on each side a delicate chain swags across the cheek to the ring around the nostril wing on the same side, passing well below the eye and clear of the lips, and one more fine chain hangs in a soft curve under the jaw from one ear to the other; the chains are thin enough that every piece and her whole face stay clearly visible. A forehead pendant: a fine gold chain runs along the centre parting of her hair and ends in a teardrop gem pendant resting at the middle of her forehead. A nose-to-ear chain: a fine chain swags from the ring on her left nostril wing across the cheek, well below the eye and clear of the lips, up to a hook at the top of her left ear. The left and right sides are balanced. The pieces are spread over the whole face in clear rows so every one reads individually, with bare skin between them; the eyes and eyelids stay clear. All the ear weights hang from the bottoms of this iron ring, and they are not counted in the piercing total: on each ear there are exactly ten separate massive solid weights, each of a different shape: on the left ear a thick solid disc like a weight plate on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid pyramid-shaped lump with a wide base on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a small solid kettlebell with a thick short handle on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a chunky solid hexagonal block on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid rough cube-shaped block on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid rough boulder-like lump on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid squat hammer head block on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid thick rectangular ingot block on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a short thick solid cylinder stump on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid rough cannonball on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links; on the right ear a solid pyramid-shaped lump with a wide base on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid rough boulder-like lump on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a thick solid disc like a weight plate on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid rough cannonball on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a short thick solid cylinder stump on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid rough cube-shaped block on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid thick rectangular ingot block on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a chunky solid hexagonal block on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid squat hammer head block on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a small solid kettlebell with a thick short handle on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links. On each ear the single iron ring carries all the weights, hanging in a staggered cluster on chains of different lengths and staggered at different heights so every weight is fully visible and none hides another. Every single weight is an enormous, dense, completely solid, squat, blunt lump of rough black cast iron, at least as big as her whole fist and clearly larger than her earlobe, with no thin parts, no arms and no hollow parts; its size does NOT shrink just because there are many of them: the last weight is exactly as big, as thick and as heavy-looking as the first. Each weight alone looks like it weighs several kilograms, each chain is pulled bar-straight and taut, and at a glance every single one looks crushingly, unmistakably heavy, the chains hanging freely in the air, clear of her neck and shoulders, with even the longest chain and its weight ending no lower than the level of her collarbones, never below them and never resting on her chest or body. Because all the load is carried by one opening, the weight gently pulls each earlobe down a little into a slightly elongated, soft, healthy loop of skin, only a small natural droop that is just enough to show how heavy the weights are; the lobe never stretches long, never tears or collapses and never hangs down to her neck or shoulder, her head stays upright, and the skin stays smooth and intact, fully healed, with no tearing, no wound, no blood and no redness. The face and ear jewelry is real mixed yellow gold, silver and rose gold set with glossy multicoloured enamel and rainbow gemstones, while the hanging weights are always black cast iron, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Hair: her hair is swept back behind both ears, leaving both ears, her jawline and her neck fully visible so every hanging piece is in clear view.

Lighting: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
